scope: Three in-progress completed YCB-V image receipts only. No final coverage or pose-accuracy claim; no GT, model inference, new registration/ICP, evaluator, locks or GPU/worker jobs.

selection_snapshot.rule: Floor25/50/75percent indices of sorted prediction-bearing complete receipts. First retained prediction with a new CAD ID chose1/6/14 without index shifts.
selection_snapshot.interpretation: Physical observations only; unsampled results not audited.

limitations: All three samples are from early scene48 and do not estimate full YCB-V accuracy.
Only CADs referenced by these three image target lists are checked numerically; no all21 CAD deep audit.
Finite poses/features, high geometry scores and consistent projections do not establish GT pose correctness.
Translation-NMS distance is a frozen reproduction assumption; feature/joint scores are not calibrated probabilities.
preservation_action: Only this new separate report is written; original source, inputs, CAD textures, feature/PCA caches, predictions, metrics, primary summaries and status remain unchanged.
